quote: Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: If you are not preparing for potential failure you are not prepared.
author: Epictetus

quote: Is a world without pain possible? Then don't ask the impossible.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: Is do not be unhappy before the crisis comes... We are in the habit of exagerating, or imagining, or anticipating, sorrow.
author: Seneca

quote: It does not matter what you bear, but how you bear it
author: Seneca

quote: It is unrealistic to expect people to see you as you see yourself
author: Epictetus

quote: Love the hand that fate deals you and play it as your own...
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: The greatest blessings of mankind are within us, and within our reach
author: Seneca

quote: The impediment to action advances the action
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: Throw me to the wolves, and I will return leading the pack.
author: Seneca

quote: To be like the rock that the waves keep crashing over. It stands unmoved and the raging of the sea still falls around it.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: We suffer more in imagination than in reality
author: Seneca

quote: When a man knows not to which port he sails, no wind is favourable.
author: Seneca,the younger.
